output.revised_prompt:
Create a production-ready portrait 2:3 backdrop asset for a mobile slot game in Cocos Creator: an original full-height “pearl fortune” themed premium physical casino slot machine cabinet, shown in an exact straight-on front orthographic view with no perspective distortion. One freestanding cabinet fills approximately 96% of image height and 94% of image width, fully visible and centered, with all functional regions symmetrical, unobstructed, and suitable behind live reels and controls.

Cabinet design: unmistakably a real, high-end physical slot cabinet with a friendly rounded Art Deco silhouette; a rounded pearl-shell crown; warm individual bulb marquee lighting; physically plausible molded pearl-ivory enamel body; refined pale champagne-gold and soft rose-gold metal trim; deep warm burgundy lacquer control deck and lower pedestal; glass, enamel, polished metal, inset bulbs, subtle seams and realistic manufacturing details. Soft celebratory wealth, elegant and inviting, never severe or royal.

Required layout, all blank and text-free: near the top, a centered blank deep-burgundy marquee panel framed in champagne gold; directly below, a small blank ivory balance capsule; in the upper-middle, one large empty pale-cream reel aperture, wide enough for five equal reel columns, perfectly clean with no reel symbols, dividers, text, markings, or UI; below it, a narrow blank win plaque; then a physical burgundy control deck with two small recessed button wells on the left, one large central circular spin-button recess, and one smaller auto-button recess on the right, all blank and unlabelled. The lower pedestal is burgundy with a large centered pearl medallion, completely blank.

Decorative integration: elegant pearl ropes incorporated into the side columns, plus blank embossed-style gold coins with absolutely no symbols or markings, and small refined ruby, emerald, and diamond accents mounted into the architecture. Gems must be restrained, physically attached, and integrated into the cabinet—not oversized, detached, floating, or cluttering live UI zones. Controlled subtle diamond sparkle only.

Background: softly blurred upscale champagne-toned casino lounge, bright and welcoming, shallow depth of field, understated and secondary, no readable signage, no people, no other prominent machines. Lighting combines warm marquee bulbs with soft cream daylight and attractive commercial product lighting. Festive, polished, premium, highly attractive, photorealistic 3D advertising render.

Palette: pearl ivory, pale champagne gold, soft rose gold, deep warm burgundy, with small emerald and ruby accents.

Strict constraints: empty reel aperture with no symbols; all marquee areas, capsules, plaques, medallions, buttons, and coins blank; no characters; no text; no letters; no numbers; no logos; no watermark; no currency symbols; no candy; original design only. Avoid palace imagery, throne imagery, cathedral forms, solemnity, dark casino atmosphere, black-dominant cabinet, neon cyberpunk, cheap yellow plastic, excessive ornament, detached oversized gems, perspective angle, cropped cabinet, and clutter over live UI zones.
